description: 本期我们邀请到了USC在读博士生Nick学长！Nick学长博士期间主要在USC和丰田研究院研究机器人的智能控制算法，他心拥有机器人的未来世界是什么样的? 他对读博和做科研又有什么心得呢? 欢迎收听本期职得一聊～
classificationReason: Interview centers on a USC doctoral researcher studying intelligent control algorithms for robots and discussing robotics research.
qualityReason: The interview includes a robotics PhD's research experience and detailed treatment of foundation models, policies, control theory, safety verification, generalization, data, and career context.
